From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: data handling recap + opt-out confirmation

Hi Samir — great to speak this morning. Quick recap and the asks we agreed on during the discovery: 

- You confirmed that FinTechCo will require an explicit opt-out for any use of customer data to train or improve models (i.e., no training on customer data by Redwood).
- Data residency: production inference will remain in us-west (primary) and backups in us-east; you requested a written confirmation and pointer to our tenant settings.
- Logs & PII: you asked that request/response logs be retained for 90 days, with PII redaction enabled in the pipeline and access limited to named Redwood engineers via a JIT process.
- Evidence: you requested SOC 2 summary and the specific config steps we'll take to ensure training opt-out; Rishi will confirm legal language.

Next steps (action owners):
- Rishi: provide formal confirmation of the training opt-out and the wording we can include in the contract (cc'd).
- Me: create a mutual action plan doc and enable the tenant-level training opt-out flag; share SOC 2 snapshot and the step-by-step export.
- Samir / Legal Ops: confirm the retention window (90 days) and if you need a longer retention or different log export cadence.

If that matches your notes, please reply here to confirm the opt-out so I can set the tenant config and attach the opt-out steps.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — that aligns with our notes. To confirm from FinTechCo side: 

- We require Redwood to opt-out of using any FinTechCo customer data for model training or improvement. Explicit, tenant-level opt-out required.
- Retention: 90 days for request/response logs is fine for now; please include a mechanism for on-demand exports for audits.
- PII handling: we require PII redaction by default and a clear list of fields you consider PII for our integration.

Can Rishi provide the formal confirmation text we should include in our SOW? Legal Ops would like the exact wording for the contract redline. Also please send the SOC 2 snapshot and the training-opt-out steps you mentioned.

Samir

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-07-09T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Post-call: data handling recap + opt-out confirmation

Samir — thanks, confirming from Legal/Compliance side. Below is the formal confirmation text you can use in the SOW and contract redline: 

"Redwood confirms that it will not use any FinTechCo customer data, including but not limited to request/response payloads, customer-provided prompts, or derived features, to train, fine-tune, or otherwise improve Redwood models or model weights. This restriction applies at the tenant level and is effective upon the customer's written confirmation and activation of the training-opt-out configuration flag in the customer's Redwood account."

Operational notes: 
- We will enable the tenant-level training-opt-out flag once we receive an explicit written confirmation (Samir's reply here suffices).
- Retention: logs will be retained for 90 days by default; exports for audits can be produced on demand as CSV/NDJSON.
- PII redaction: we will apply Redwood's standard PII redaction pipeline. Please review appendix A (fields considered PII) — if you need custom redaction rules we can add them as a scoped change order.

I've attached the SOC 2 summary and a short internal runbook that the ops team will follow to flip the flag and verify no training hooks are enabled for your tenant.

Attachment: SOC2-snapshot-2026-06.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)
Attachment: redwood-training-opt-out-steps.pdf (PDF, 45 KB)

If that wording works, Marissa — please proceed to enable the flag and create the MAP so FinTechCo can sign off. Happy to hop on a quick call if Legal Ops wants to walk through the language.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
